title: Customer Intent to Contact Dealer or Take Follow-Up Action
summary: These fragments mainly record customers’ stated plans to contact the dealer, return for service, or take another follow-up step, without enough outcome detail to determine sentiment.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews describe intended next steps such as visiting the dealer, returning to service, checking an issue later, or making a purchase to enable a feature, but they do not state clear outcomes or evaluations.

limitations: All sampled fragments are undetermined, so the topic captures follow-up intentions rather than clear satisfaction or dissatisfaction.

The cluster mixes several unrelated situations, including dealer visits, service return plans, feature access, window tinting, wind noise, and later tracking, so a single coherent issue cannot be inferred.
Some fragments are too brief to identify the underlying problem or result, such as the statements about doing so shortly or trying to track it later.
